# Agent Avatar Generator
> Self-hosted deterministic avatar generation for AI agents

## What This Does
Generates unique, deterministic avatars from seed strings (agent IDs, emails, names).
Same input always produces the same avatar. No accounts, no storage, no auth needed.
Supports PNG, SVG, and animated GIF output.

## Quick Start
Generate an avatar: GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}
Generate as SVG: GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}?format=svg
Generate animated GIF: GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}?format=gif&frames=10&delay=8
Generate with style: GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}?style=robot&size=256

## Endpoints

### Generate Avatar
GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}
- Query: style (geometric|rings|robot|blockies|gradient|initials|starburst|mosaic|pixel|sunset|constellation), size (16-1024), format (png|svg|gif), background (hex), theme (warm|cool|ocean|forest|sunset|neon|pastel|monochrome|earth)
- GIF params: frames (2-30, default 10), delay (1-100 centiseconds, default 8 = 80ms/frame)
- Returns: image/png, image/svg+xml, or image/gif
- GIF responses include X-Frame-Count header
- No auth required

### List Styles
GET /api/v1/styles
- Returns: JSON array of available styles with descriptions

### List Themes
GET /api/v1/themes
- Returns: JSON array of available color themes with descriptions

### Batch Generate
POST /api/v1/avatar/batch
- Body: {"seeds": ["a","b","c"], "style": "geometric", "size": 128, "format": "png", "theme": "warm"}
- For GIF: add "frames": 10, "delay": 8
- Returns: JSON with base64-encoded images, generation_ms, and count
- Images generated in parallel for performance
- Max 50 seeds per request

### Gallery ZIP Download
POST /api/v1/avatar/gallery/zip
- Body: {"seeds": ["a","b","c"], "style": "geometric", "size": 256, "format": "png", "theme": "warm"}
- For GIF: add "frames": 10, "delay": 8
- Use style: "all" to include every style for each seed
- Returns: application/zip with avatar files
- Images generated in parallel, ZIP assembled sequentially
- Headers: X-Generation-Time-Ms, X-Avatar-Count
- Max 50 seeds per request
- Filenames: {seed}.{format} or {seed}_{style}.{format} (when style="all")

### Health
GET /api/v1/health
- Returns: {"status": "ok", "service": "agent-avatar-generator", "version": "..."}

## Styles
Each style has a unique animation when rendered as GIF:
- geometric: 5×5 grid with vertical symmetry (default) — brightness pulse
- rings: Concentric colored rings — pulsating ring widths
- robot: Procedural robot faces with 4 head shapes, 6 antenna styles, eye glow — eye blink animation
- blockies: 8×8 colored grid (Ethereum-style) — brightness pulse
- gradient: Two-color gradient with geometric overlay — angle rotation
- initials: 1-2 letter initials on colored background — brightness pulse
- starburst: Radial rays from center with fading edges — rotation
- mosaic: 6×6 grid of shapes with harmonious colors — brightness pulse
- pixel: Retro pixel art creatures with horizontal symmetry — color cycling
- sunset: Layered horizon bands with sun glow — sun movement + color shift
- constellation: Network graph — 7-14 nodes connected by edges, hub-and-spoke topology — node pulse

## Color Themes
Apply a color theme to any style:
GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}?theme=warm

- warm: Reds, oranges, and yellows
- cool: Blues and cyans
- ocean: Teals and deep blues
- forest: Greens and earth tones
- sunset: Pinks, reds, and oranges
- neon: High-saturation on dark background
- pastel: Soft, light colors
- monochrome: Grayscale only
- earth: Browns, tans, and muted tones

Themes are optional. When omitted, the default color palette is used.
Same seed + same theme = same output (deterministic).

## Key Properties
- Deterministic: same seed → same avatar, always (GIFs too)
- Stateless: no database, no storage
- No auth: all endpoints are public
- Cache-friendly: immutable responses with far-future cache headers
- Rate limited: 200 requests/minute per IP
- Performance: parallel generation for batch/ZIP, timing headers (X-Generation-Time-Ms)

## Share URLs
/avatar/view/{seed}?style=geometric&size=256
- Renders preview page with download links (PNG + SVG)

## Integration
- OpenAPI: GET /api/v1/openapi.json
- Skills: GET /.well-known/skills/agent-avatar-generator/SKILL.md
- Source: https://github.com/Humans-Not-Required/agent-avatar-generator
